name: Antigravity Remote Control
description: Antigravity CLI (agy) with its Remote Control daemon supervised by supervisor instead of systemd/launchd

instanceName.description: Instance name shown in Remote Control (--remote-control-name). Empty = keep whatever the language server has saved, or let it generate one.

autoUpdate.description: Let agy self-update: runs the background updater before each launch, matching the systemd unit's ExecStartPre.

autostart.description: Start the daemon automatically via supervisor. Needs a completed one-time sign-in (run 'agy-remote-control-login'), otherwise the daemon exits immediately.
